implementation: Flat native speed plus item speed, native Garen Q percentage and current relic haste summed before soft caps; same effective speed used by Stats and walking.
limits: Soft-cap thresholds/ratios sourced from supplied community Stats.cs; original Riot runtime equivalence unproven.
Community applies caps before percentage modifiers; current implementation applies them afterward as a reconstruction.
Q plus relic additive stacking, slow ordering/resistance and all other speed effects require historical qualification.
Body collisions, dashes, blinks and forced movement remain incomplete.
